subject: Next steps & rotating windows for technical deep dive
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Walker <sarah.walker@novushealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps & rotating windows for technical deep dive

Hi Sarah —

Great 30-minute call earlier — thanks for walking through Novus Health's immediate priorities (real-time patient summaries, sub-second retrieval for triage, and audit logging requirements). Per our discussion, next logical step is a 60-minute technical deep dive with our infra/SE team to align on latency targets, data flow, and integration constraints.

Quick recap and asks:
- Goals: confirm integration approach (API vs. private deployment), validate latency SLOs at 99th pct, and surface any networking/KMS requirements.
- Attendees we recommend: you (product/engineering), my SE (Mina), our solutions PD (Grace), and Karuna (Novus infra) if available.
- Duration: 60 minutes.

To make this practical across your distributed team, we propose a rotating series of windows so participants in US/EU/APAC have at least one fair slot over a 3-week cycle. Proposed rotating slots (all times shown in UTC for easier cross-region comparison):

Option A (rotation template) — 3-week cycle:
1) Week 1: Tue 16:00 UTC (US morning / EU afternoon)
2) Week 2: Thu 08:00 UTC (APAC friendly / US late evening)
3) Week 3: Wed 13:00 UTC (EU/US overlap)

We can also condense to 2 options if narrower availability needed. I attached a one-sheet availability grid (novus-availability-grid.csv) and a suggested agenda (deep-dive-agenda.pdf).

Please reply with: 1) preferred rotation cadence (3-week/2-week), 2) any absolute blackout windows, and 3) who will attend from Novus (names + roles). If easier, there is a short Doodle poll here: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd1234-rotate-windows

I'll hold the rotating-series calendar invites tentatively once you confirm preferences, then send a single ICS you can forward.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.com]
[Attachment: novus-availability-grid.csv (spreadsheet, 1KB)]
[Attachment: deep-dive-agenda.pdf (PDF, 18KB)]

From: Sarah Walker <sarah.walker@novushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Karuna Patel <karuna.patel@novushealth.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & rotating windows for technical deep dive

Thanks Karthik — helpful summary.

We like the rotating approach and would prefer the 3-week cadence so our engineers in APAC and EU get at least one convenient slot. Blackouts: our engineering offsite the week of Jan 4-8 (all day), and the Celeste/Platform team is generally unavailable on Fridays.

Tentative attendee list from Novus:
- Sarah Walker (Product Lead)
- Karuna Patel (Infrastructure Engineer)
- Rajesh Mehta (Security) — may join for a portion to validate KMS/audit questions

Preferred initial slot: Week 1 Tue 16:00 UTC works for leadership; if you can alternate Week 2 to APAC-friendly times, that should cover our team. I'll ask Rajesh if Thu 08:00 UTC works for him; if not, he'll dial into the recording.

Please go ahead and tentatively schedule the first three sessions and share the series invite so I can confirm with Karuna and Rajesh.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Walker
Senior Product Manager — Novus Health
[sarah.walker@novushealth.com]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & rotating windows for technical deep dive

Karthik — thanks for the write-up.

Short notes from SE side:
- 60 minutes is tight but doable; propose: 10m intros, 15m Novus context, 25m tech Q&A (latency/kv, cache, quantization tradeoffs), 10m next steps/action items.
- We should allocate ~15 minutes to review network/KMS requirements up front so Rajesh can confirm on the call rather than at the end.
- Availability for Mina/Grace: Week 1 Tue 16:00 UTC — OK; Week 2 Thu 08:00 UTC — OK but Mina will join from home and may be on slightly delayed connection; Week 3 Wed 13:00 UTC — OK.

I'll prepare a lightweight runbook and share before the call. Also recommend we capture one or two sample prompts and expected token lengths ahead of time so we can tailor quantization/latency guidance.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: invite-rotating-series.ics (calendar invite)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Walker <sarah.walker@novushealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karuna Patel <karuna.patel@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & rotating windows for technical deep dive

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Sarah.

I have: 1) scheduled the first three deep dives as a recurring rotating series (60 minutes), 2) attached the ICS for you to forward, and 3) added a mutual action plan to the HubSpot deal. Links/attachments below.

Confirmed series (UTC):
- Session 1 (Week 1): Tue Jan 12 16:00 UTC — internal invite to Novus attendees sent
- Session 2 (Week 2): Thu Jan 21 08:00 UTC — APAC-friendly
- Session 3 (Week 3): Wed Jan 27 13:00 UTC — EU/US overlap

If any of these hit your offsite blackout (Jan 4-8), they are already outside that window; still, let me know if you need to shift the first occurrence.

Action items:
- Novus: confirm final attendee list for Session 1 and send 2-3 representative prompts + expected token counts (Sarah/Karuna/Rajesh)
- Redwood: Mina to share runbook + pre-reads; Grace to add a short section in the MAP about fallback policies and SLOs

Attachments included: invite-rotating-series.ics, novus-availability-grid.csv, deep-dive-agenda.pdf
HubSpot MAP link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/novus-health/deal/NOVUS-2026-057

I'll keep the invites tentative until you confirm the attendee list, but the series is blocked on our side. Looking forward.

Cheers,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
